prompt:
Images: ['West_view.png']
Question: This is the West elevation of a building. Reading strictly left to right, list every dimension label along the bottom horizontal dimension chain in order (in mm), and for each window/door rectangle shown, state its position in that left-to-right sequence (i.e. which gap it sits after) and its approximate width label. Also note how many distinct window openings and how many door openings are visible.
system_prompt: Answer only the supplied local visual question using tools. Inspect a suitable crop; cite original pixel locations of marks. Separate door arcs, gaps and dimension ticks. State uncertainty; do not infer a connection just because rooms are adjacent. Do not plan the whole building.
